verdict.rationale: Twenty's pricing page explicitly lists 'MCP server | Yes | Yes | Yes' across all plans, confirming an official MCP server offering that would let AI agents connect. However, this is the only evidence — there's no dedicated documentation page explaining setup, capabilities, or authentication for the MCP server, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of it working. Missing for 10: dedicated MCP server docs/setup guide, independent verification that it works, details on scope/permissions for MCP connections.
